name: Text Encode
description: Turns a prompt into conditioning for the Sampler, with the model's text encoder, and carries the reference pictures of an edit to it. Kept while only the sampling changes, so a new seed does not encode the prompt again.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: What the image should not show. Used only when the Sampler's guidance is not 1.

inputs.name: references
inputs.label: References
inputs.description: Pictures to edit or take from, for a model that edits (FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image Edit). Each goes to the model at most a megapixel; Resize to Megapixels sets it.
